changed.title: Find a bounded nonlinear-depth selector exceeding the two-binomial-sum rank budget
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C ∧ depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 ∧
    budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d) < A.rank

changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let F := ZMod 2
∀ s k : ℕ,
  let pairs := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s × Fin s)).filter (fun ij =>
    ij.1 < ij.2 ∧ ij.1.val % (2*k+1) ≠ ij.2.val % (2*k+1))).card
  let bound := if k = 0 then 2*s else 2*k+4*s+4*pairs
  let fit := fun (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) =>
    ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (cut : ℕ), cut ≤ C.gates.length ∧
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n+m) C ∧
      (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
      (C.gates.take cut).countP nonlinear ≤ s ∧ (C.gates.drop cut).countP nonlinear ≤ k ∧
      (∀ d ∈ depths (n+m) ⟨C.gates.take cut,0⟩, d ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ d ∈ depths (n+m+cut) ⟨C.gates.drop cut,0⟩, d ≤ 1) ∧
      PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let rk := fun {n m : ℕ} (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m) =>
    let bit := fun i j => if G i j then (1 : F) else 0
    let X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) F := fun i j => bit i j + bit i v + bit u j + bit u v
    X.rank
  IsGreatest {r : ℕ | ∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool)
    (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m), fit n m G ∧ rk G u v = r} bound

  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin n → F
  ∀ f : X → F,
    let B := fun u v : X => f (u+v)+f u+f v+f 0
    (∀ p u v : X, f (p+u+v)+f (p+u)+f (p+v)+f p=B u v) →
    let m := (n-(Nat.card {u : X // ∀ v : X, B u v=0}).log2)/2
    Nat.card {x : X // f x=0} ≠ Nat.card {x : X // f x=1} →
    ∀ j : ℕ,
      let s := j/2
      let base := (1 : ℚ)/2^m
      let best := (1 : ℚ)/2^(m-s)
      let freq := (1 : ℚ)/2^s
      let advantage : ℚ := if 2*m ≤ j then 1 else if j=0 then 0
        else if j % 2 = 1 then best else 3*best/(3+2*freq-2*best*base)
      let p := (1+advantage)/2
      let can := fun T : ℕ => 0 < T ∧
        ∃ (A : Fin T → X →ₗ[F] (Fin j → F)) (out : Fin T → (Fin j → F) → F),
          ∀ x : X, p*(T : ℚ) ≤ (Nat.card {seed : Fin T // out seed (A seed x)=f x} : ℚ)
      (∃ T, can T) ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, can (2^t) ↔
        if 2*m ≤ j then True else if j=0 then 0 < t
        else if j % 2 = 1 then 2*(m-s) ≤ t else False) ∧
      (0 < j → j < 2*m → j % 2 = 0 →
        let K := 2^s
        let H := 2^(m-s)
        let M : ℕ := ((3*K+2)*H^2-2)/6
        1 < M ∧ Odd M ∧ ∀ T, can T → 2*M ∣ T)
changed.unlocks: Decides exactly which widths permit optimal pointwise prediction with a fixed number of fair bits, and how many bits are required when attainable. At interior even widths it also constrains every arbitrary uniform seed count.
changed.context: At interior odd width, optimality forces constant pointwise accuracy. All 4^m Walsh frequencies must be covered by seed row spaces sharing zero, forcing more than 2^(2m-j) seeds. Read s complete pairs and choose one signed residual Fourier character uniformly to attain the bound in fair bits. At positive even j<2m, the supporting prior is positive on both fibers, so success is exactly p at every input. Reducing p gives denominator 2M with M=((3K+2)H^2-2)/6 odd and above one, K=2^s, H=2^(m-s). Clear rational weights for finite uniform attainment.

changed.title: A supplied adaptive pair probe tree admits polynomial certification and optimal circuit fits at each transposition size
changed.statement:
let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]
let pairs := fun n : Nat => (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i =>
  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
let fast := fun g : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) g,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ solve : List Bool → List Bool, fast solve ∧
∀ (k : Nat) (crown : Bool), 2 ≤ k → (crown = true → 7 ≤ k) →
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  ∀ (hard : List ((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)))
    (soft : List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)),
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ ∀ h ∈ hard, f h.1 h.2 = crown
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let probe := fun f : Fn => (pairs k).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let vs := (pairs k).toFinset
  ∀ tree : List (List Bool × (Fin k × Fin k)),
  let keys := tree.map Prod.fst
  keys.Nodup → (∀ a e, (a,e) ∈ tree → e ∈ vs) →
  (∀ a bit, a ++ [bit] ∈ keys → a ∈ keys) →
  let atNode := fun (a : List Bool) => (tree.find? (fun r => decide (r.1 = a))).map Prod.snd
  let route := fun f : Fn => (List.range tree.length).foldl (fun a _ =>
    (atNode a).elim a (fun e => a ++ [decide (e ∈ probe f)])) ([] : List Bool)
  let good := ∀ a : List Bool, ∃ (b : Int) (w : Fin k × Fin k → Int), ∀ f : Fn,
    fits f → route f = a → (score f : Int) = b + (probe f).sum w
  let mask := fun S : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ S))
  let banks := fun z : (Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool) => List.ofFn z.1 ++ List.ofFn z.2
  let x := [crown] ++ header k ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap banks ++
    header soft.length ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => banks t.1 ++ [t.2]) ++ header tree.length ++
    tree.flatMap (fun t => header t.1.length ++ t.1 ++ header t.2.1.val ++ header t.2.2.val)
  let bits := fun z : Nat => (List.range (soft.length.log2+1)).map (fun j => z.testBit j)
  (good → ∃ slot : Fin (k/2+1) → List Bool,
    solve x = [true] ++ (List.finRange (k/2+1)).flatMap slot ∧
    ∀ s, let present := ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val
         (¬present → slot s = List.replicate (1+(pairs k).length+soft.length.log2+1) false) ∧
         (present → ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val ∧
           (∀ g : Fn, fits g → (probe g).card = s.val → score g ≤ score f) ∧
           slot s = [true] ++ mask (probe f) ++ bits (score f))) ∧
  (¬good → ∃ (a : List Bool) (P T : Finset (Fin k × Fin k)) (cube : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Fn),
    P = ((tree.filter (fun t => (t.1 ++ [true]).isPrefixOf a)).map Prod.snd).toFinset ∧
    Disjoint P T ∧ 2 ≤ T.card ∧
    (∀ U ⊆ T, fits (cube U) ∧ route (cube U) = a ∧ probe (cube U) = P ∪ U) ∧
    T.powerset.sum (fun U => (-1 : Int)^(T.card-U.card)*(score (cube U) : Int)) ≠ 0 ∧
    solve x = [false] ++ header a.length ++ a ++ mask P ++ mask T)
changed.unlocks: Allows all-size optimal fitting with a supplied adaptive tree in polynomial input time, and returns a physical obstruction when the tree fails.
changed.context: Follow each transcript to fix its true pairs and ban its false pairs. Drop inconsistent leaves. Delete the endpoints of true pairs, remove banned pairs and account for forced samples. Search each residual instance for a nonzero coefficient extending two distinct pairs. A witness gives the stated alternating cube on that leaf. Otherwise empty and singleton scores give its affine weights. For each size solve exact-cardinality weighted matching and keep the best physical witness over all leaves.
